Terms of Service

Last updated: [[EFFECTIVE_DATE]]

The short version: be decent in chat, don't cheat or sell game items for real money, and you must be at least 13. In-game gold and items have no cash value. Supporter is a monthly subscription you can cancel any time. You can download your data or delete your account from Settings.

1. Who we are

Wayfolk ("the game", "we", "us") is run by [[OPERATOR]], [[ADDRESS]]. You can reach us at [[CONTACT_EMAIL]].

By creating an account or playing as a guest, you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you don't agree, please don't use the game.

2. Who can play

  • You must be at least 13 years old, or older if your country requires it to use an online service like this one without a parent's consent (for example, 16 in some EU countries). If you're under 18, your parent or guardian must agree to these terms, and must agree to any purchase.
  • One person per account. Keep your password private: you're responsible for what's done with your account.
  • A guest account lives only in the browser it was made in. If you clear your browser's storage or lose the device, a guest account can't be recovered. Save it with an email or Google in Settings to keep it.

3. Playing fairly

You agree not to:

  • use bots, scripts, macros or modified clients, or exploit bugs, to gain an advantage;
  • attack, overload or try to get into the game's servers or other players' accounts;
  • make several accounts to get around a mute, ban, limit or reward rule;
  • buy, sell or trade accounts, gold or items for real money or anything outside the game;
  • pretend to be a moderator, the game's staff, or another player.

If you find a bug or exploit, please tell us instead of using it.

4. Chat, names and what you post

The game has public chat channels, guild chat, game-table chat and private whispers between friends. You're responsible for what you write, and for your display name and any guild name or guild notice you set.

Don't post anything that:

  • harasses, threatens, bullies or targets anyone;
  • is hateful toward people for who they are (race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexuality, disability and the like);
  • is sexual, especially anything involving minors - which we report to the authorities;
  • is spam, a scam, or an attempt to get someone's password or personal details;
  • shares someone else's private information;
  • breaks the law or someone else's rights.

Never share your own password, address or other personal details in chat. We will never ask for your password.

You keep ownership of what you write. You give us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to store, show and send it to other players as the game needs to work, and to use it for moderation.

Ideas, suggestions and feedback about the game are welcome, but they're given freely: we may use, change or build on any of them, or not, without paying you, crediting you or owing you anything. Please don't send us art, music, writing or code you want to keep the rights to - if you do, you give us the same freedom to use it.

5. Moderation

Any player can block or report another. Reports are reviewed by moderators. When enough established players report someone in a short time, the game may mute them automatically for a while.

If you break these terms we may, depending on how serious it is: remove content, change a name, mute you, take away gold or items gained unfairly, or suspend or close your account. We'll usually warn you first, but we don't have to for serious or repeated breaches. If you think we got it wrong, email us.

6. Gold, items and other virtual things

  • Gold, items, heroes, cosmetics and everything else in the game are virtual. You get a personal, revocable licence to use them in the game. You don't own them, and they have no cash value.
  • Gold can't be bought with real money and can't be cashed out. The market and the card tables use in-game gold only.
  • We may change, rebalance or remove game features, items or rewards as the game develops. We'll try to be fair about it, but we don't owe anything for changes to virtual things.

7. Supporter subscription

  • Supporter is an optional monthly subscription that gives the perks listed in the game's Premium window at the time you subscribe. The price is shown before you pay.
  • Payments are handled by Stripe. We never see or store your card details.
  • It renews automatically each month until you cancel. You can cancel any time from Premium, then Manage. Your perks stay until the end of the month you've paid for, then stop.
  • We may change the price or perks. A price change only applies from your next renewal after we've told you about it, and you can cancel before then.
  • Refunds are covered by our Refund Policy.
  • Taxes may be added where the law requires.

8. Your account and your data

You can download a copy of your data, or delete your account, at any time from Settings. Deleting your account removes your heroes, gold, items, friends and everything else, and can't be undone. If you're a Supporter, deleting your account cancels your subscription straight away. How we handle your data is in our Privacy Policy.

A guest account nobody has signed in to for 180 days is deleted, with everything in it.

9. The game is provided as it is

We work hard to keep the game running and fair, but it's provided "as is" and "as available". It may have bugs, lose progress, be down for maintenance, or change. To the extent the law allows, we give no warranties beyond those in these terms.

Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have under consumer law that can't be excluded.

10. Our liability

To the extent the law allows, we're not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for the loss of virtual items or progress. Our total liability to you for anything to do with the game is limited to the amount you've paid us in the 12 months before the claim, or USD $50, whichever is more.

This doesn't limit liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that can't be limited by law.

11. Ending things

You can stop playing and delete your account whenever you like. We may close the game, or your account under section 5. If we close the whole game, we'll give at least 30 days' notice in the game and stop charging subscriptions.

12. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. For significant changes we'll tell you in the game before they take effect. Continuing to play after that means you accept them; if you don't, you can delete your account.

13. Law and disputes

These terms are governed by [[GOVERNING_LAW]]. If you have a problem, please email us first - most things can be sorted out quickly. If you're a consumer, you can also bring a claim in the courts where you live, and you keep the protections of your local consumer law.

Questions? Email [[CONTACT_EMAIL]].
